name: Pong Remake Project 1
author: xxsoranogenkai
description: My first finished project of 2023. Made in about 5-6 hours over a couple of days. First time not following a step by step tutorial. This is a 2 player game. Player 1 controls the purple paddle using W for up and S for down. Player 2 uses the up and down arrows for movement to control the blue paddle. First to 5 points wins!!
